description:
Rewrite lib/tailscale_transport.ex to use the new GenTailscale module
instead of :gen_tailscale/:gen_tailscale_socket.

This should be mostly a simplification — the new API is designed
to match what ThousandIsland.Transport needs.

Key changes:
  - listen: call GenTailscale.listen/2, pass through tailscale config opts
  - accept: call GenTailscale.accept/1
  - send/recv: delegate to GenTailscale
  - setopts/getopts: delegate to GenTailscale
  - controlling_process: delegate to GenTailscale
  - sockname/peername: delegate to GenTailscale
  - getstat: delegate to GenTailscale
  - close/shutdown: delegate to GenTailscale
title: Update TailscaleTransport to use new GenTailscale
